test_closeLot_fromWordReceived().notice: 20. closeLot from WORD_RECEIVED state → merchant can close a stuck lot

test_closeLot_notMerchant().notice: 7. A different wallet cannot closeLot on another merchant's lot

test_createLot_approvedStore().notice: 4. Approved wallet CAN createLot, and lots[lotId].merchantAddress == msg.sender

test_createLot_maxEntrantsExceedsHardCap.notice: 1. createLot reverts LotNotOpen when maxEntrants > MAX_ENTRANTS (500)

test_enter_atExactCloseAt().notice: 3. enter() at exact entryCloseAt boundary → EntryAlreadyClosed

test_enter_entrantLimitReached().notice: 2. entering when entrant limit is reached reverts EntrantLimitReached

test_promoteWaitlist_afterFixedDeadline(.notice: 11. promoteWaitlist on a fixed-deadline lot → always PromotionAfterDeadline     Promotion is fully disabled for fixed-deadline lots regardless of timing.

test_promoteWaitlist_atExactDeadline().notice: 13. promoteWaitlist at and after fixedDeadlineAt boundary     paymentDeadline[slot] == fixedAt (new behaviour).     At block.timestamp == fixedAt: DeadlineNotReached passes (block.timestamp > paymentDeadline     is false since they are equal — wait, check is <=, so at equality DeadlineNotReached fires).     Actually: check is `block.timestamp <= paymentDeadline` → at equality it reverts DeadlineNotReached.     At fixedAt + 1: slot expired AND fixedDeadlineAt > 0 → PromotionAfterDeadline fires.

test_promoteWaitlist_fixedDeadline_alway.notice: 19. promoteWaitlist on fixed-deadline lot always reverts PromotionAfterDeadline     regardless of timing — promotion is fully disabled for fixed-deadline lots.

test_promoteWaitlist_invalidSlot().notice: 3. promoteWaitlist with winnerSlot >= actual winner count reverts InvalidWinnerSlot

test_promoteWaitlist_relativeGivesNewWin.notice: 14. promoteWaitlist relative mode → new paymentDeadline == block.timestamp + paymentWindow

test_promoteWaitlist_relativeMode_newWin.notice: 21. promoteWaitlist relative mode: promoted winner gets block.timestamp + paymentWindow     (not the original slot deadline)

test_promoteWaitlist_relativeMode_stillW.notice: N4. promoteWaitlist relative mode still works after contract change

test_promoteWaitlist_tooLateForFixed().notice: 12. promoteWaitlist on a fixed-deadline lot mid-window → PromotionAfterDeadline     Promotion is fully disabled for fixed-deadline lots. Even at a timestamp     before fixedAt, any promote call immediately reverts PromotionAfterDeadline.     paymentDeadline[slot] == fixedAt, so DeadlineNotReached fires before      PromotionAfterDeadline when block.timestamp <= fixedAt.

test_purchase_afterSlotDeadline().notice: 18. purchase strictly after slot deadline → reverts DeadlineExpired     slot deadline = fixedAt; purchase() checks block.timestamp > paymentDeadline.     At exactly fixedAt, the check (== paymentDeadline) does NOT revert (strict > boundary).     At fixedAt + 1 (one second past), the check fires → DeadlineExpired.

test_purchase_atExactFixedDeadline().notice: N1. purchase at block.timestamp == fixedDeadlineAt → succeeds (strict > check; equality is valid)

test_purchase_withinSlotDeadline().notice: 17. purchase at fixedAt - 1 (1 second before slot deadline) → succeeds

test_requestDraw_atExactCloseAt().notice: 5. requestDraw() at exact entryCloseAt → succeeds (strictly less than check)

test_requestDraw_fixedDeadlinePassed().notice: 6. requestDraw() when block.timestamp >= fixedDeadlineAt - MIN_PROMOTE_LEAD → DeadlineAlreadyPassed

test_requestDraw_notMerchant().notice: 6. A different wallet cannot requestDraw on another merchant's lot

test_revokeStore_blocksNewLots().notice: 5. Revoking a store prevents NEW lot creation; existing lots remain active

test_selectWinners_fixedDeadlineViabilit.notice: 16. selectWinners reverts DeadlineAlreadyPassed when block.timestamp >= fixedAt - MIN_PROMOTE_LEAD

test_selectWinners_usesRelativeWindow().notice: 10. selectWinners with fixedDeadlineAt == 0 → paymentDeadline == block.timestamp + paymentWindow

test_setVenueOperator_notMerchant().notice: 8. A wallet that is not the lot's merchant cannot setVenueOperator

test_setVenueOperator_ownerCannotBypassM.notice: 9. Even the contract owner cannot setVenueOperator on another merchant's lot

test_storeIsolation().notice: 10. Store A cannot requestDraw or closeLot on store B's lot
